$comment: Gzip (level 9) byte budgets for the web app's client JavaScript, measured on the webpack build by scripts/ci/bundle-budget.mjs: about 10% above the measurement of main at 2026-10-31 08:57 UTC (shared 134215, largest route 378757 for /app/me, all chunks about 628 KB). The first measurement that morning was 334266 for the largest route; work merged during the day added about 13%. Raising a budget needs a reviewed reason; INTL-003 is expected to lower them. 2026-10-31 evening, ADM-002: the hub console adds its own route group (/admin, /admin/setup/[step] and one route for every console section) with about 6.7 KB of page chunks and no shared-chunk growth; main measured about 687,600 bytes for all chunks (671.5 KiB, LANG-ES, SANC-001 and others merged that day), the console brings it to 694,643, so the all-chunks budget moves from 691200 (675 KiB) to 701440 (685 KiB). Shared and largest-route budgets are unchanged. 2026-10-31 night, CTRY-003: the four example packs gain sourced v2 facts, and the country-packs module ships every pack to the client (the /app/me route among others), so all chunks grow from about 696,600 bytes (680.3 KiB on main at ce71ddb) to 704,502 (688.0 KiB) and the largest route from 397.4 to 405.1 KiB; the all-chunks budget moves from 701440 (685 KiB) to 711680 (695 KiB). Shared and largest-route budgets are unchanged. Follow-up: keep pack facets on the server (the browser needs only the v1 fields), which removes this growth and most of the US pack from the client. 2026-11-01, wave-3 integration (#358): eight API packages together put /app/me at 417,124 bytes, 356 over the largest-route budget although each fit alone; the largest-route budget moves from 416768 (407 KiB) to 419840 (410 KiB). The country-pack facets in the client (about 110 KiB) remain the cause; moving them to the server is the next web package and will lower every budget. 2026-11-01, country packs in the browser: client components read packs through @trustwork/country-packs/client (the v1 subset of the built-in packs, about 6.5 KB gzip instead of about 94 KB for every pack with its facets, the validator and the country dataset); the visitor's own pack, when the bundle lacks it, arrives from the server as the same subset. Measured on main at 71453f9 (WEB-005 merged) before and after: shared 134137 and 134137, largest route 408672 (/(public)/[lang]/magazine/[issue]/read) and 356895 (/app/me, was 401865), all chunks 699221 and 648696. After the wave-3 integration (main at bf95eef, /app/me recorded above at 417124): shared 134137, largest route 358582 (/app/me), all chunks 650911. The budgets move to about 10% above that measurement: shared from 148480 (145 KiB) to 147456 (144 KiB), largest route from 419840 (410 KiB) to 394240 (385 KiB); all chunks stay at 711680 (695 KiB), already 9.3% above 650911, so 10% would be a raise. serverOnlyMarkers: text only country-pack facets, their schemas and the country dataset carry; the step fails when any client chunk contains one. 2026-11-01, HUBC-020 (#513): the console's scoped navigation, Users home and synthetic approval inbox add client code for the admin route group only; all chunks measure 712,372 bytes (695.7 KiB), 692 over. The all-chunks budget moves from 711680 (695 KiB) to 716800 (700 KiB), 10.1% above the 650911 measurement recorded above plus the console growth since. Shared and largest-route budgets are unchanged.
